evidence.effect: 2Y auction pre-auction price decline (supply pressure), own tenor
evidence.rule: On each 2-year note auction date: short from 180 min before the competitive close (13:00 ET = 12:00 CT) to 1 min before the close: return P(-1)/P(-181)-1
evidence.conversion: ZT point value $2,000 (rules/products.py:156, tick 0.00390625 pt = $7.8125); ticks per bp of notional = P/39.0625; P = 105 assumed (range 101.5-110.5 gives x0.967-1.052) [price level unverified: search snippets only, Barchart ZTU23 101-155 on 2023-09-29, 110-13 on 2020-10-05]; cash 2Y on-the-run price return taken equal to ZT return (CTD duration close to the OTR 2Y; approximation); 0.733 bp x 105/39.0625 = 1.97 ticks (range 1.91-2.07)
evidence.sample: On-the-run cash 2Y note mid quotes, GovPX 1991-2000 and BrokerTec 2001-2024, 1-minute; auctions 1991-06-25..2024-07-24
evidence.decay_evidence: Pre leg not split by subperiod; combined price pressure (both legs) 1.348 bp 1991-2006, 1.852 bp 2007-2014, 0.887 bp 2015-2024 (Table 3 Panel B); S3=S2 F-test 1.867 (not significant for 2Y)
evidence.source: Fleming, Liu, Nguyen (2026), Intraday Price Pressure and Order Flow Around U.S. Treasury Auctions, FRBNY Staff Report 1188 (Mar 2026, rev. Jul 2026), Table 3
evidence.quote_location: Table 3 (PDF p. 48), 2-Year column, Panels A and B

evidence.effect: 2Y auction post-auction price recovery, own tenor
evidence.rule: On each 2-year note auction date: long from the minute after the auction results release (0+) for 180 min: P(+180)/P(0+)-1
evidence.conversion: ZT point value $2,000 (rules/products.py:156, tick 0.00390625 pt = $7.8125); ticks per bp of notional = P/39.0625; P = 105 assumed (range 101.5-110.5 gives x0.967-1.052) [price level unverified: search snippets only, Barchart ZTU23 101-155 on 2023-09-29, 110-13 on 2020-10-05]; cash 2Y on-the-run price return taken equal to ZT return (CTD duration close to the OTR 2Y; approximation); 0.603 bp x 105/39.0625 = 1.62 ticks (range 1.57-1.71)
evidence.decay_evidence: As E1 (combined 0.887 bp in 2015-2024, about 0.44 bp per leg if split equally: about 1.19 ticks; split not reported)
evidence.source: Fleming, Liu, Nguyen (2026), Intraday Price Pressure and Order Flow Around U.S. Treasury Auctions, FRBNY Staff Report 1188 (Mar 2026, rev. Jul 2026), Table 3

evidence.effect: Auction spillover to the 2Y note from 3Y, 5Y, 10Y auctions (yield pressure, both legs)

proposed_features.name: zt_cpnauc_mto / zt_cpnauc_msince (2Y-note pressure clock on 2Y, 3Y, 5Y and 10Y auction dates)
proposed_features.source: Fleming, Liu, Nguyen (2026), Intraday Price Pressure and Order Flow Around U.S. Treasury Auctions, FRBNY Staff Report 1188 (Mar 2026, rev. Jul 2026), Table 4 and Section 4.1
proposed_features.quote: 2-Year 0.712*** / 3-Year 0.677*** / 5-Year 0.966*** / 10-Year 1.013*** (Table 4, 2-Year secondary column); 'Yields rise steadily in the hours leading up to the auction and reverse in the hours following the release of auction results' (p. 4)
proposed_features.formula: For ZT row (d, t): A_d = sorted CT instants T_a of TREASURY_AUCTION rows dated d with original tenor in {2Y, 3Y, 5Y, 10Y} (T_a = closing_time_comp ET converted to CT; same frozen convention as k2_auction). mto = min(T_a - t) over T_a in A_d with T_a >= t, in minutes, flag 1; else 0, flag 0. msince = t - max(T_a) over T_a in A_d with T_a + 4 min <= t (the offset K2-aucpost uses, aucpost.py:34), flag 1; else 0, flag 0. Uses no bar.
proposed_features.derivation: Full sample, 5Y/10Y-auction days: 0.97-1.01 bp yield (two legs) x 1.876 = 1.81-1.90 bp price, about 0.93 bp per 180-min leg (equal split assumed) = 2.5 ticks at P=105. The V2.2 clock captures at most 60 of the 180 pre-auction minutes (t2 10:20 h60) and 120 of the post-auction minutes starting 48 min after results (t3 12:50 h120); with linear accrual (assumed; the paper says 'steadily') that is 1/3 and 2/3 of a leg: about 0.8 and 1.7 ticks. Applying the 2Y own-tenor post-2015 ratio 0.419/0.712 = 0.59 (spillover decay not reported): about 0.5 and 1.0 ticks. Best case t3 h120 post-2015 about 1.0 tick.
